description: Evaluate JavaScript in the active page and return the result plus delivery and retry. Off by default: runs only when the server was started with NORACU_ENABLE_EVAL=1 (eval_disabled otherwise), and never when NORACU_DISABLE_EVAL=1 or in your own Chrome (browser_launch chrome:true). When the page navigated while the script ran, a line after the result says so.
name: browser_evaluate
